name: What is single window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single window replacement involves removing an existing window unit and installing a new, complete window into the same opening. This process typically includes replacing the frame, sash, and glass. It's often chosen when the existing window frame is damaged, deteriorating, or when a complete upgrade to energy efficiency and aesthetics is desired. Unlike insert replacements, which keep the old frame, single window replacement offers a fresh start for the entire opening, allowing for structural repairs and full customization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Single window replacement involves removing an entire old window unit and installing a new one, including the frame, sash, and glass.
